name: Truppen & Omklädningsrummet (squad list)
purpose: Primary roster workspace: review every own player's form, physical state, contract and squad role; set captain and squad-status tier; pick two players to compare.
actions: Switch view tab (Översikt / Prestation / Fysisk status / Kontrakt)
Filter by position (select + 7 position chips below table)
Filter by state (Tillgängliga / Otillgängliga / Energi under 75%)
Toggle form mode (last 5 played vs last 5 fixtures incl. DNP)
Change squad-role tier per row (inline select)
Tick up to 2 players for compare/captaincy
structure: Photo EnvironmentBanner (dressing room) with 3 metric tiles (squad size, match fitness avg, captain) and 2 CTA buttons; SquadDepth strip (7 position cards); a hm-tabs row of 4 buttons; one Panel with filter bar and a horizontally scrolling hm-roster-table whose columns change per tab (Overview shows ~19 columns: checkbox, Nr, Spelare, Pos, Ålder, Moral, Trupproll, M, Starter, Mål, Skott%, Räddn%, Betyg, Form(5M), Energi, Matchträning, Tillgänglighet, Återkomst, Avtal till); duplicate position-chip row after the panel.
strengths: Very data-rich, real handball stats (shot % / attempts, save % / faced) with tooltips explaining Matchträning vs Energi
Per-workspace state memory (useWorkspaceState) keeps filters/sort/tab between visits
Inline squad-role select makes promises/roles actionable without leaving the list
Form sparkline + morale badge give at-a-glance signals
Captain/vice/7m role pills inside the player cell
weaknesses: Overview tab is the union of Performance + Physical: ~19 columns, forcing horizontal scroll even on desktop
Position filter duplicated (select in filter bar + chip row placed below the table, easy to miss)
Compare and captaincy hidden behind a checkbox selection with max 2; captain can only be set from that aside (vice-captain/7m not editable here)
Physical tab adds 3 columns only visible there (Belastning 7 d, Trend, Återhämtning) – workload story split across tabs
No bulk actions, no saved views, no column chooser
Tab buttons use aria-pressed instead of tablist semantics
desktop: Single column, full width; table relies on .hm-scroll-x horizontal scrolling.
mobile: No page-specific breakpoint for the roster table; squad-season.css has @media (max-width:800px/1250px) for depth/heading only – table becomes a sideways-scrolling 19-column grid.
opportunities: Card/list hybrid with a player "chip" showing energy, fitness, morale and form as micro-visuals; columns become optional
Positional depth chart (court-shaped) instead of a flat strip
Saved views (e.g. "Matchday readiness", "Contract risk") replacing 4 hard tabs
Multi-select tray with actions (compare, set roles, rest, list for transfer)

name: Tab "Översikt"
purpose: Default view combining performance, physical and contract-end columns.
structure: Roster table with performance + physical columns + Avtal till.
weaknesses: Widest table in the game; least scannable
opportunities: Make overview a curated 6–8 column summary with expandable rows

name: Tab "Prestation"
purpose: Season output per player.
actions: Sort by M, Starter, Mål, Betyg
structure: Columns M, Starter, Mål, Skott % / försök, Räddningar % / mötta, Betyg (1–10 avg), Form (5M) sparkline.
strengths: Shooting and save efficiency shown with sample size
weaknesses: Shot% and save% not sortable; no per-60 or per-match normalisation
opportunities: Small multiples / sparkline per metric; position-aware metric sets (GK vs outcourt)

name: Tab "Fysisk status"
purpose: Readiness: energy, match fitness, 7-day load, load trend, recovery outlook, availability and return date.
structure: Columns Energi %, Matchträning %, Belastning 7 d, Trend (↑/→/↓), Återhämtning (God/Normal/Nedsatt, reasons in tooltip), Tillgänglighet badge, Återkomst date.
strengths: Separates energy (day form) from match fitness (match sharpness)
Reasons for recovery outlook available as tooltip
weaknesses: Readiness reasons hidden in title tooltips (not touch-accessible)
No visual thresholds/trend lines; numbers only
opportunities: Readiness heat-strip per player (energy, fitness, load ratio) with explicit risk bands

name: Tab "Kontrakt"
purpose: Contract end and wage per player.
structure: Columns Avtal till, Lön / månad, Åtgärd link; drops Trupproll column.
weaknesses: Duplicates /career/contracts (SQD-05) with fewer features; link goes to profile, not to the renewal panel
opportunities: Remove in favour of a single contracts surface or deep-link to renewal

name: Selection aside "Spelardossier & jämförelse"
purpose: Appears when 1–2 rows ticked: availability/energy/fitness line, captain button, dossier link, compare CTA in panel header.
structure: aria-live aside above the table listing chosen players with inline buttons.
weaknesses: Mixes two unrelated jobs (compare vs captaincy)
Compare CTA lives in panel header, far from the aside
opportunities: Floating selection tray with contextual actions

name: Panel "Truppens balans" (SquadDepth)
purpose: Available/total per primary position (V6, V9, M9, M6, H9, H6, MV).
structure: Overline "SJU POSITIONER. ETT LAG." + 7 position cards.
weaknesses: Not clickable as a filter even though a separate chip row does exactly that
Ignores secondary positions
opportunities: Court-shaped depth chart with secondary-position depth and click-to-filter

name: Empty filter state
purpose: "Inga spelare matchar dina filter." under an empty table.
weaknesses: Reset button not repeated in the empty state
opportunities: Empty state with one-click reset

name: Spelarprofil (player dossier)
purpose: Single dossier for ANY player (own, external, free agent, retired): identity, condition, morale/person management, ability/attributes (full for own, knowledge-gated for external), scouting report, contract, transfer status, medical, history.
actions: Own: Matchtrupp & startsju / Kontraktsöversikt / Träning & belastning links
Answer player concerns, transfer requests, list/unlist, release (with confirm)
Open renewal talks / submit renewal offer / withdraw
structure: Photo PlayerHero (dressing-room backdrop) with back button; PlayerActions button row; own-player Tillstånd panel; hm-profile-tabs (6 buttons); body is hm-profile-split (main column + hm-world-rail) whose content is recomposed per tab from shared blocks (attributes, ability, contract, history, body, report, medical).
strengths: Strong knowledge-gating model: external players never expose raw CA/PA or 1–20 grid; ranges and tiers instead
Own players get a full 56 outcourt / 21 GK attribute grid with family radar
Person-management (morale factors, promises, concerns as DecisionCards) lives where the player is
Context-aware back button and own vs external action sets
weaknesses: Six tabs reuse the same blocks in different combinations (ability panel appears in 3 tabs, body profile in 3, medical in 2, PlayerPerformance in 2) – tabs feel redundant
Tab "Profil & egenskaper" and tab "Egenskaper" overlap heavily
Heavy inline styles (hex colours, px) instead of tokens in panels
Stars-only CA/PA (1–5) for own players hides the meaningful 1–200 scale progression; development tab shows stars as text "★★★☆☆"
Tab state is local useState (not in URL) – deep links like "open contract tab" impossible (other surfaces link only to the profile root)
Fallback mock attribute set (Tekniska/Mentala/Fysiska) uses a different vocabulary than gameplay ratings
mobile: profile-world.css: ≤1250px collapses to one column and rail becomes 2-col grid; ≤760px further stacking. Attribute grid uses auto-fill minmax(205px) so it reflows.
opportunities: Collapse to 3–4 purposeful tabs (Overview, Attributes & development, Contract & transfer, History) with URL-addressable tabs
Attribute visualisation with history deltas (development events carry previous→new values)
Knowledge uncertainty as visual ranges (error bars) rather than text ranges
Unified "person" timeline: morale factors, promises, talks, injuries, transfers

name: Tab "Profil & egenskaper" (overview)
purpose: Season-in-numbers strip, PlayerDynamicsPanel (own), attributes; rail with ability, scout report (external), medical and a "Din nästa bedömning" note.
weaknesses: Very long scroll for own players: dynamics + full 56-attribute grid
opportunities: Summary hero with key ratings; push detailed grids to Attributes tab

name: Tab "Prestation & historik"
purpose: Season performance strip, last 12 matches table (Datum, Match, Resultat, Start, Min, Mål/skott, Räddningar, Betyg) and season history table.
weaknesses: No charts; same component reused in "Klubbhistorik" tab
opportunities: Rating/goal trend chart; per-match drill to match report

name: Tab "Egenskaper"
purpose: Attribute grid in main column; rail with ability, body profile and scout report.
weaknesses: Near-duplicate of overview tab
opportunities: Merge with overview or turn into a comparison-ready attribute workspace

name: Tab "Utveckling"
purpose: Own: current level & potential stars, individual focus label, last 5 development events. External: explanatory note only.
structure: Key-value rows + event list; body profile; rail ability + medical.
weaknesses: Read-only: individual focus cannot be changed here (lives on Training)
Star text strings instead of a progression visual
opportunities: Development curve (CA over time vs PA band), editable focus in place

name: Tab "Kontrakt"
purpose: Contract panel (owning club, wage, end, shirt no.) + renewal flow, transfer status card, market value (exact for own, range for external); rail club history & training compensation.
strengths: Renewal shows demand factors with ±% chips and expected role
weaknesses: Market value and contract split across 3 panels; no wage-budget context inline
opportunities: Contract "deal sheet" with budget impact bar and demand breakdown chart

name: Tab "Klubbhistorik"
purpose: Club history entries (age ranges), training compensation breakdown, then PlayerPerformance again; rail body profile.
strengths: Training compensation explained separately from market value
weaknesses: Repeats performance tab content
opportunities: Career timeline visual

name: PlayerHero + PlayerActions
purpose: Identity header (name, number, position, age, nation, club colours, status, squad tier, captain/7m) + contextual action buttons.
structure: Photo hero band followed by a row of small buttons.
weaknesses: Action row is a flat list of 3–4 equal-weight buttons; primary action unclear for own players
opportunities: Sticky compact hero with one primary contextual CTA

name: Panel "Tillstånd" (PlayerConditionPanel)
purpose: Own players: availability chip, selectable state, injury & rehab, return date, match-fitness band, two <meter> bars (Energi, Matchträning).
weaknesses: Native <meter> styling inconsistent across browsers
opportunities: Condition gauge set shared with squad and matchday

name: Panel "Spelaren som person" (PlayerDynamicsPanel)
purpose: Morale meter (0–100, target), morale factor chips, intention summary, pre-contract warning, player concerns with option buttons, transfer request DecisionCard (accept/promise/refuse), promises list, incoming bids, transfer-list and release actions with inline confirm.
structure: pd-panel section with header meter and stacked decision cards.
weaknesses: Destructive "Bryt avtalet" is a small button next to transfer listing
Status messages rendered as plain text line
opportunities: Person timeline + mood chart; separate danger zone

name: Panel "Spelaregenskaper (skala 1–20)" (GameplayAttributesPanel)
purpose: Own players: radar of 6 outcourt families (Teknik, Perception/beslut, Taktik, Försvar, Fysik, Mental) or 4 GK families, family averages with bars, then every attribute (56 outcourt / 21 GK) with a tier-coloured bar and value; dots mark evidence-backed/editor values.
structure: Dark gradient header strip (160px radar + family tiles) then FamilyBlocks in auto-fill grid.
strengths: Complete, well-grouped attribute model; radar gives shape at a glance
weaknesses: Hard-coded hex colours/gradients; tier colours (≥15 green, ≥12 blue, ≥9 grey, else amber) not tokenised
No comparison/delta, no position-weighting highlight
opportunities: Role-weighted highlights, deltas since last month, compare overlay

name: Panel "Förmåga & Positionskarta" (GameplayAbilityPanel)
purpose: CA/PA as 1–5 stars, mini-court with 7 position spots (primary highlighted), attack and defence role proficiencies as text.
structure: Stars rows + SVG mini court + role rows.
weaknesses: Only primary position lit; secondary positions and proficiency levels not visualised
opportunities: Position suitability heat on court (primary/secondary/role proficiency)

name: Knowledge-gated panels (external players)
purpose: External players: ability/potential as star ranges (e.g. "2–4 ★") with knowledge tier badge (Mycket begränsad / Begränsad / Måttlig / God kännedom); attributes reduced to strengths/weaknesses lists.
structure: Two panels replacing ability and attribute panels.
weaknesses: Text-only; uncertainty not visual
Low-knowledge message offers no direct "scout now" button in this panel
opportunities: Range bars that tighten as knowledge grows; inline scout CTA

name: Panel "Scoutingrapport" (ScoutReportPanel)
purpose: Estimated market value range, scout confidence %, recommendation text, strengths/weaknesses, report history (scout + date), "Scouta spelare" CTA or no-scout notice.
strengths: Report metaphor with stamp and history
weaknesses: Only latest report shown; no diff between reports
opportunities: Report timeline showing how ranges narrowed

name: Panel "Förläng kontrakt" (ContractRenewal)
purpose: Renewal state machine: intention summary, blocker note, open talks, demand vs current wage, expected role, demand factors (±%), last response quote, waiting state with answer date, offer form (1–4 years, wage, optional role promise), signing MomentHero after agreement.
structure: pd-renewal block inside contract panel (also embedded on /career/contracts).
strengths: Asynchronous negotiation made explicit (answer next day)
weaknesses: Feedback via a plain status line; no budget impact shown
opportunities: Show payroll/budget delta and acceptance likelihood

name: Panel "Transferläge" (PlayerTransferCard)
purpose: Ownership vs playing club chips, loan progress line, contract facts, competing interest, promise kept/broken, negotiation CTA with deadline clock.
strengths: Loan progress bar and deadline urgency
weaknesses: Uses Transfer Centre visual skin (tc-*) inside profile skin – visual mismatch
opportunities: Unified card system

name: Panel "Medicinskt" (MedicalPanel)
purpose: Availability, active injury type/severity/rehab phase/return date/rehab %, last 5 injuries.
weaknesses: Duplicates Tillstånd panel facts for own players; no link to /career/medical
opportunities: Body map / rehab timeline

name: Loading / not-found states
purpose: "Läser in spelarbetyg…" while real-world ratings fetch from /api/game-world/gameplay-ratings; "Spelaren hittades inte." when id unknown.
weaknesses: No skeleton; not-found has no way back
opportunities: Skeleton states; not-found with search/back

name: Spelarsök (player market search)
purpose: Search every non-own, non-retired player in the world; shortlist; open dossier/scouting/transfer.
actions: Filter position, max age, nationality, competition, contract (expiring / free agents)
Open profile / Scouta / Öppna bud & budget
structure: PageHeading + "game-market-stage" band with 3 counters (players on market, shortlist, scouts); two-column layout: results Panel (6-filter bar, 9-column table, pager) + sticky "Spelardossier" aside with PlayerHero, KnowledgeMeter, facts and 3 CTAs.
strengths: Knowledge meter per row communicates uncertainty
weaknesses: No ability/potential/value column – the only sortable quality signal is goals
Overlaps heavily with Transfer Centre "Hela marknaden" and Recruitment Centre lists (3 player-market tables)
Pagination instead of virtualised list
Default selection silently picks first row of page
opportunities: Merge into one Market workspace with Recruitment/Transfers
Show knowledge-gated ability range as a visual band column
Saved searches and need-based presets

name: Dossier aside "Spelardossier"
purpose: Selected player preview.
structure: Heading + tag, PlayerHero, knowledge meter, 3 facts, 3 buttons.
weaknesses: Shows no ability information even when known
opportunities: Mini scout report in dossier

name: Jämför spelare
purpose: Side-by-side comparison of two players (own or external) with role-relevant attributes.
actions: Pick Spelare A / B from grouped selects (Din trupp / Övriga världen)
structure: Two selects; Panel "Profil & prestation" (15-row comparison table: klubb, position, ålder, kännedom, bedömd nivå range, styrkor, utvecklingsområden, matcher/starter, mål/skott, skotteffektivitet, räddningar, snittbetyg, energi, avtal, lön); Panel "Egenskaper för <pos>" with 6 position-relevant 1–20 attributes (own players only); action rows; empty state if B missing.
weaknesses: Select lists contain every player in the world (thousands) with no search
No visual diff (bars/radar overlay), no winner highlighting
External attributes blank in the attribute table
opportunities: Searchable picker, radar overlay, delta bars, "compare against squad average"

name: Kontrakt (contracts overview)
purpose: Plan renewals: who expires, days left, wages, payroll; open renewal for a player.
structure: PageHeading + 4-cell summary (expiring ≤1y, ≤180d, monthly payroll, link to squad); two-column hm-contract-layout: "Avtalsöversikt" 7-column table (Spelare, Pos, Avtal till, Dagar kvar countdown, Lön, Status badge, Åtgärd) + decision panel (ContractRenewal) or prompt "Vem bygger du vidare med?".
weaknesses: No sorting (header "Avtal till ↑" is static text)
No wage budget headroom shown although renewal depends on it
Staff contracts not included
mobile: squad-season.css collapses hm-contract-layout (1.9fr + 280px) to one column at the max-width:1250px breakpoint; renewal panel then sits below a scrolling 7-column table.
opportunities: Contract timeline (Gantt of contract ends vs season boundaries)
Payroll vs budget bar with projected renewals

name: Panel "Ditt avtalsbeslut"
purpose: Embedded renewal flow for selected row.
structure: Player cell + days left + explanatory paragraph + ContractRenewal.
weaknesses: Selection kept in workspace memory; stale selection persists across visits
opportunities: Side drawer

name: Personal – Organisation
purpose: See the club organisation (departments, positions, holders, vacancies, costs vs board limit), staff list with role suitability and this week's coaching responsibilities.
actions: Navigate staff subnav (Organisation / Vakanser / Rekryteringsmarknad / Förhandlingar / Ansvarsområden)
structure: SectionScene header with crest; hm-subnav with badges; OrganisationChart band (cost MeterBar, 3 stats, "Behov just nu" list, 5 department columns of position cards, collapsible responsibilities); split: role-count grid + 4-column staff table; rail with weekly coach responsibilities and a note.
strengths: Org chart by department with filled/covered/vacant/combined states
Staff cost vs board limit meter
Needs list surfaces vacancies and expiring contracts
weaknesses: Three overlapping representations of the same staff (org chart cards, role-count grid, staff table)
Suitability shown as 1–5 stars everywhere except scouting page (x/20)
"Relevanta egenskaper" column is a text list of attribute names, not values
mobile: ≤900px departments and band to 1 column; ≤600px stats to 1 column.
opportunities: Single interactive org chart as the page; table as optional view
Coaching-quality impact visual (staff → training quality per session type)

name: Staff subnav (StaffNav)
purpose: Five-item sub-navigation shared by staff pages with vacancy and open-negotiation badges.
structure: hm-subnav links; Vakanser/Förhandlingar are query views of /career/staff/recruitment.
weaknesses: Mixes routes and ?view= query states; Rekryteringsmarknad and Vakanser render on the same page with stacked legacy content
opportunities: Consistent tab model

name: Panel "Klubbens organisation" (OrganisationChart)
purpose: Departments (Ledning, Tränare, Rekrytering, Akademi, Stöd), positions, board members, costs, needs.
structure: xp-band header with meter + stats, needs list, st-depts grid, details/summary.
weaknesses: Dense small text; wage/contract info per card
opportunities: Visual tree with health colours

name: Staff table + role counts
purpose: Role counts per STAFF_ROLE and sortable table (Namn, Roll, Relevanta egenskaper, Lämplighet stars).
weaknesses: Redundant with org chart
opportunities: Remove or turn into compact list view

name: Rail "Veckans tränaransvar"
purpose: Which coach leads each session this week.
weaknesses: No session type shown here (only coach + date)
opportunities: Mini week grid

name: Personprofil (staff profile)
purpose: Assess a staff member (own, other club, free agent): role fit, attributes (ranges when knowledge <90%), ambition, employment, impact, hire/renew/dismiss, this week's responsibilities.
actions: Erbjud kontrakt / Erbjud förlängning (role, years, wage, responsibility scope, signing bonus, promise)
structure: SectionScene (role eyebrow, name, StaffMark) + main column (Lämplighet RoleFit, StaffAttributes with compare-to-current-holder, club history) + rail (Anställning, Karriärambition & roll with knowledge meter, StaffImpact, StaffDealPanel, Aktuellt träningsansvar).
strengths: Knowledge-gated staff attributes with range display and "take references" action
Deal panel shows budget guardrails (cash, staff limit, projected cost, over-budget warnings)
weaknesses: Ambition panel is styled with inline rgba/hex values; mixed dark-on-light panels
Deal form has 6 fields with no preview of acceptance
Not-found state is a bare text panel
opportunities: Staff "card" with role-fit radar and delta vs holder
Negotiation stepper consistent with player negotiation room

name: Panels "Lämplighet" + "Egenskaper för rollen" (StaffInsight)
purpose: Role suitability per role (1–20 → 1–5 stars, verbal label) and role-relevant staff attributes, with ranges under uncertainty.
weaknesses: Stars hide the 1–20 resolution
opportunities: Range bars

name: Panel "Värva / Förläng eller avsluta" (StaffDealPanel)
purpose: HIRE or OWN deal flow with financial overview and dismissal DecisionCard.
structure: st-deal section: stepper, 6-cell finance grid with warnings, form, status notes, DecisionCard.
weaknesses: Dismissal confirm inline (no modal) under the hire form
opportunities: Shared negotiation component with REC-04

name: Rekrytera personal
purpose: Find staff candidates (free agents + employed) across every role; view vacancies and staff negotiations.
structure: SectionScene with counters; StaffNav; optional vacancies/negotiations list section; StaffMarketBoard (8-column table: Namn, Roll, Tillgänglighet, Bedömd lämplighet stars with "?" when knowledge<60, Mot i dag delta, Ambition, Förväntad lön, Kännedom %); then a legacy split with "Fria scouter" table rail and "Rekrytering — Personal" 5-column table with role chips.
strengths: StaffMarketBoard compares candidate to current holder ("Mot i dag")
weaknesses: Two market tables on one page (new StaffMarketBoard + legacy table + free scout table) – duplicated and contradictory filters (?role= only applies to the board)
Legacy role chips use inline accent styling
Vacancies/negotiations views stack above the full market instead of replacing it
desktop: Board full width, legacy split below.
opportunities: One staff market with saved role filters; vacancies as entry cards

name: View "Vakanta tjänster"
purpose: List vacant roles with "Visa kandidater →".
weaknesses: Empty state "Alla tjänster är tillsatta." only
opportunities: Vacancy cards with impact of filling

name: View "Förhandlingar"
purpose: Last 20 staff negotiations (hire/renewal) with stage.
weaknesses: Answers arrive in inbox, not here; no CTA to respond
opportunities: Negotiation board shared with player transfers

name: Panel "Hitta rätt person" (StaffMarketBoard)
purpose: Primary staff market table.
weaknesses: See STF-03

name: Legacy tables "Fria scouter" + "Rekrytering — Personal"
purpose: Older candidate tables still rendered below the board.
weaknesses: Redundant; candidate to remove
opportunities: Remove

name: Ansvarsfördelning (delegation)
purpose: Decide per responsibility area whether the manager does it, staff advises, or staff acts (Du själv / Råd först / Delegera); approve/reject staff proposals; read staff activity log.
structure: PageHeading + StaffNav; dg-panel "Vem gör vad" 5-column matrix (Område, Rollen som äger det, Ansvarig + stars, Läge segmented radios, Vad det innebär); dg-panel "Förslag från staben" DecisionCards + decided list; dg-panel "Vad staben har gjort" log (≤25).
strengths: Clear delegation model with explained scope per area
weaknesses: Training-plan proposals cannot be approved here (button disabled, redirect)
Log is a long ordered list without filters
opportunities: Delegation as toggles on each domain page (contextual) + central inbox of proposals

name: Träning & Återhämtning
purpose: Plan the training week (day types, up to 2 sessions/day with type, intensity, duration, target group, responsible coach), apply templates, set per-player load and individual development focus, monitor energy/match fitness and development.
actions: + Lägg till pass / Ta bort pass
Per session: type (12), intensity (4), duration (3), target (4), coach
Per player: load setting (Full/Reducerad/Endast återhämtning/Vila), individual focus (7)
Jump to match prep / report from match day cell
structure: EnvironmentBanner (training hall) with 3 metrics; "Veckans matchberedskap" band with 3 numbers + compact MatchHero; TrainingFeedback; AssistantTrainingPanel; "Veckoschema" panel with 7-column day grid (each day: date, day-type select or match link, session cards each with 4–5 selects); "Spelarberedskap" 5-column table; "Utveckling" 6-column table.
strengths: Match days are embedded in the week and link to prep/report
Session cards colour-coded by category and intensity
weaknesses: Each session card is a stack of 4–5 native selects – extremely dense, no drag/drop, no visual load budget
Weekly load/energy forecast not shown – the player readiness consequence of the plan is invisible until days execute
Duplicate metrics: banner and week band both show sessions/recovery/energy
"Senaste förbättring" column prints the raw attribute key (e.g. FINISHING) not the Swedish label
Terminology drift: Matchträning / matchform / "MF" for the same metric
Locked (executed) days only show a "Genomförd" badge, no outcome
desktop: 7 day columns minmax(150px) (175px at large) inside horizontal scroller.
mobile: No mobile layout for the week grid: always 7×≥150px columns → sideways scrolling ≥1050px; tables scroll.
opportunities: Visual week planner (drag session blocks, load bar per day, projected energy curve per player group)
Per-player load/readiness chart linking to squad physical tab
Development panel showing attribute deltas and focus effect

name: Panel "Assistentens träningsplan" (AssistantTrainingPanel)
purpose: Delegation mode for training (Du själv / Råd först / Delegera), request weekly proposal, show proposal goal, planned sessions/intensity and individual advice; approve/decline.
structure: Section with mode buttons, proposal table (Spelare / skäl, Belastning).
weaknesses: Placed above the planner; competes for attention
opportunities: Show proposal as a diff overlay on the week grid

name: Panel "Veckoschema" (week planner)
purpose: Edit the week.
strengths: Category pills, matchday highlight, today highlight
weaknesses: Select-heavy
opportunities: Block-based planner

name: Panel "Spelarberedskap"
purpose: Per player: energy badge (Pigg/Något sliten/Trött), MF %, recent load, load setting select (constrained by injury/limited), individual focus select; status badges (injured/rehab/return/placement).
weaknesses: "Senaste belastning" is an unexplained decaying magnitude; differs from squad "Belastning 7 d"
opportunities: Merge with squad physical view

name: Panel "Utveckling"
purpose: Per player: age, level stars, potential stars, status (Förbättras/Tränar/Ingen data), latest improvement.
weaknesses: Raw attribute key and stars as text
opportunities: Development leaderboard / growth chart

name: TrainingFeedback block
purpose: Collapsed <details> "Senaste träningsutfall · date": per player sessions attended, energy before/after and change for the latest executed training day.
structure: details + Panel table (Spelare, Pass, Energi före, Energi efter, Förändring).
strengths: Only place showing the actual energy cost of training
weaknesses: Collapsed by default and only for the latest day; no history

name: Loading state
purpose: Suspense fallback "Förbereder träningsveckan…".
weaknesses: No skeleton
opportunities: Skeleton

name: Matchplan & Taktiktavla 2.0
purpose: Choose match squad (≤16) and starting seven, defensive specialists/exchanges, special situations (6v5, 5v6, 7v6), team style (defence 6-0/5-1, aggression, tempo, attack identity, rotation, 7v6 policy), assistant rotation, 7m takers, captaincy/leadership, for the next fixture.
actions: Drag & drop players between court slots and bench (HTML5 DnD)
Switch court mode (Anfall 6v6 / Försvar 6v6 / Byten & Diff / 6 mot 5 / 5 mot 6 / 7 mot 6)
Switch player-overlay mode (Energi / Lämplighet / Senaste match / Form 5 matcher)
Assign / remove defensive specialists, clear all exchanges

Archive variant: PageHeading, full ArchivedMatchCenter (same 4 views as live), HeadToHeadStatsComparison, MatchAftermathPanel, PostMatchPressBanner, action bar (5–6 buttons), open <details> table (Spelare, Minuter, Energi efter match, Matchbelastning, Senaste 7 dagar). Legacy variant (no archive): MatchHero with result, aftermath, "Bästa spelare", "Tabellplacering", "Matchstatistik · Jämförelse", two "spelarbetyg" tables (Mål, Skott, Betyg).
strengths: Workload table connects match minutes to the training load model (same unit)
Aftermath gives narrative closure (media, voices, flow chart)

Two divergent layouts depending on archive availability

Stats comparison rendered twice in archive variant (match center Statistik + HeadToHead panel)

Player rating chart and momentum graph as hero
